title: proofgate-judges-pytest-by-the-command-word-of-each-segment
intention: bin/cmd/proofgate refuses pytest only where pytest is the command word of a segment (past VAR=value assignments and the prefix commands, or after python -m), and judges the whole command as one more segment, so the word as an argument passes untouched and a separator inside an assignment hides no proof run.
why: 1af0564c0db3 (PROVED, cairn b919a9a) refuses any Bash text containing the word pytest: measured 2026-10-06 by scratchpad probe pg_fp.py, `echo pytest`, `grep -rn pytest cairn/` and a commit message naming it are refused though they run no pytest; the peer akiendelllinux_cc_0 reproduced `echo pytest` in its own session. The lived symptom: every session's innocent commands are blocked and must be respelled. Its clause (3) said other commands pass untouched, but its tooth never sampled the word as an argument, so the hollow went green. Also D9's measured miss: `X="a;b" python3 <proof>` passes bare because the split cuts inside the quotes.
traces_to: Law 9 (1af0's clause (3) 'other commands pass untouched' is red in the world); CP4 (a gate that blocks innocent commands chafes every session).
how: In bin/cmd/proofgate judge(): drop the whole-text PYTEST.search; add _runs_pytest(segment) beside _runs_a_proof that walks the same tokens (assignments, then PREFIXES) and is true when the command word's basename is pytest or py.test, or is python* followed by `-m pytest`. Judge segments = SEGMENT.split(command) + [command] for both pytest and the python proof run. Add teeth to bin/proofs/test_proof_gate.py under a second PROVES key for this ticket. Correct 1af0564c0db3's measured_at_build (4) through the artifact door: the hook went live mid-session.
falsifier: Done when (1) `git commit -m "refuses pytest\n"`, `grep -rn pytest cairn/`, `echo pytest` and `cat x | grep "py.test "` are judged None by bin/cmd/proofgate and pass the hook silently (exit 0, no stdout); (2) `pytest x.py`, `python3 -m pytest -q x.py`, `cd a && pytest`, `timeout 60 pytest cairn/tools/base/proofs/` and every spelling in the proof's PYTEST list are still refused with exit 2 naming `cairn test`; (3) `X="a;b" python3 cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_domain.py` is rewritten to `<repo>/bin/cairn test --exec ` + shlex.quote(original). WRONG INTENT if a pytest run reachable by a command word that this judgement cannot see is measured in the corpus of CC Bash commands (then the gate needs a shell grammar, not segments).
watchme: none, because bin/proofs/test_proof_gate.py reds on drift and the live gate's refusals land in every session's transcript
children: none, because one function in bin/cmd/proofgate and three teeth in bin/proofs/test_proof_gate.py
